type: seeded paired production-rule AI integration for C73/C74
storageIsolation: private in-memory VM Map; no browser saves or user collection touched
playerBot: Existing simulation bot, common choice-aware harness adjustments, and minimal velocity-progress fix; identical for baselines and variants.
opponentBot: Current production AI; custom Marg Chip is a VM profile override only.

metrics.velocityGranted: Actual false-to-true grant after production afterAttackEffects.
metrics.velocityUsed: Legal follow-up attack declarations including reflected attacks.
metrics.velocityDamagingHits: Follow-up normal-attack damage packets with positive actual DEF or HP damage.
metrics.slowApplications: New successful Slow states applied by production setStatus, attributed to the other side.
metrics.slowTurns: Slowed targets still present when their own turn begins.

limitations: These explicit replacement decks and deterministic bots do not establish human-play balance or a metagame tier.
Each matchup has only 20 games, evenly split first/second; small differences are noisy.
Substitutions change existing roles, cost curves and combinations, so the result does not isolate either new card alone.
The player bot favors direct LP attacks when no guard exists, and therefore does not optimize all Velocity opportunities.
Only rules and AI run headlessly; rendered cards, browser input, sound and deployment are separate checks.
